risk_levels.R0: ordinary chat or stable knowledge answer
risk_levels.R2: write durable notes, handoff docs, or artifacts
risk_levels.R4: experiment, build, performance, runtime, external research, or current factual claim
risk_levels.R5: delete, commit, install, login, payment, permission, network/firewall/proxy edit, sensitive transfer, or long-term memory write

explicit_action_negation_phrases: commit and push should not run

local_project_lane_overlay.rule: Machine-local project lane and memory-root mappings may be loaded from this overlay. Do not commit private local roots into the public policy JSON.

global_memory_lane.rule: GLOBAL memory is manual-only; do not infer it from cwd unless the user explicitly requests global memory work.

router_decision_contract.purpose: keep routing and dynamic evaluation strong but low-cost before opening deeper modules
router_decision_contract.tool_surface_discovery_rule: Use an exposed tool or skill that covers the next action directly. When a concrete capability is missing, unclear or fails, query one relevant catalogue while preserving the user's named product and scope. Verify exposure, authentication, callability and action coverage separately; refresh only the selected surface once for unchanged state.
router_decision_contract.skill_lifecycle_rule: Skill lifecycle is mandatory for skill-layer work. Keep idle skills at listing/meta-summary level; load SKILL.md and needed support files only during an active frame; after a skill phase ends, release large skill body content where the host supports context GC and retain a compact skill_release_receipt with skill_id, completed_steps, current_stage, artifact_paths, evidence_refs, open_loops, and resume_entry.
router_decision_contract.feedback_loop_profile_rule: feedback_loop_profile controls only the memory -> task-local prediction -> observation -> semantic calibration depth; it does not create standing constraints and does not replace risk, evidence, permission, lane, claim, or memory-write boundaries. Use index_hint for cheap lookup hints, record_candidate for compact write candidates, prevention_review when selected prevention memory should become a task-local candidate prediction, and explicit_cycle only for an explicit full-loop request. Deterministic runtime guards remain separate.
router_decision_contract.debt_hygiene_rule: When self-check shows substantial memory pollution, target pollution, dirty-tree debt, or accumulated technical debt in the current project or long conversation, run a debt hygiene pass: inventory and group issues, separate must-clean-now from deferrable debt, clean only the current required set, and mark deferred items as candidate_technical_debt for review during the next cleanup.
router_decision_contract.hybrid_retrieval_rule: Hybrid retrieval is an enhancement profile selected after memory_need. It must preserve meta-first lane/category narrowing and must not replace existing memory isolation, source-monitoring, or claim gates.
router_decision_contract.memory_write_profile_rule: When memory_mode is write or update, durable memory content must be context-complete and source-preserving. Explicit reusable memory, conversation-memory, and cross-conversation writes require strict capsule shape rather than orphan fragments.
router_decision_contract.read_semantic_boundary_rule: Select reading depth from semantic evidence demand, not literal keywords alone. Use exact anchors first, then original-language semantic anchors, then domain tags and near-synonym families. Negative anchors prevent false positives. If near matches point to multiple lanes, events, or meanings, keep a bounded candidate set or ask before opening payloads or writing memory.
router_decision_contract.read_depth_profile_rule: Select read depth after lane/category narrowing. Use capsule_only for ordinary orientation, segment_window for local sequence, raw_context_window for exact wording/tool logs/errors/R5/self-report/user corrections, artifact_output_window for final outputs/tests/diffs/public artifacts, cross_lane_link_review for ownership/continuation/merge/archive boundaries, source_cascade_review for domain/external/causal/conflict/source-validity claims, and full_lane_audit only for migration, cleanup, backfill, contamination review, or explicit audit.
router_decision_contract.edit_operation_profile_rule: Classify content mutation before editing. Ordinary update/sync/fix/adapt wording defaults to append_delta or in_place_patch on the selected target. section_replace is bounded by anchors. full_rewrite requires explicit whole-surface intent, generated-source truth, unavoidable schema migration, corruption, or approved cleanup/migration plan. delete_from_disk is R5. delete_record_content needs explicit scope and diff review, and high-impact records may require R5-style confirmation.

conversation_memory_full_lane_triggers.decision_rule: Create or update the active conversation memory lane when an explicit conversation-memory request is present, or when any threshold group crosses its threshold in a non-read-only task. A compaction/context-loss signal must describe an observed event or an explicit recovery request; discussion of token cost, context-window size, or compaction behavior alone does not cross this threshold. Keep conversation_memory_threshold as a backward-compatible coarse fallback.

router_decision_contract.low_cost_rule: Use microkernel -> router contract -> one matching module -> one needed gate -> one needed index -> only matching payload.

causal_attribution_contract.purpose: Output-side attribution review for high-risk causal, stability, definition, or generalization assertions. It prevents formation paths, local observations, or single cases from being written as mechanism properties or validated causality.
causal_attribution_contract.rule: Use trigger groups as a first-pass filter only. The gate should fire only on high-risk assertion patterns: abstract system/framework/mechanism subject plus causal predicate plus global effect; time-range plus stability assertion; single-sample/case wording plus generalization; or origin/path wording mixed into a mechanism definition. Scoped local causal reasoning should not trigger unless it omits the needed empirical or hypothesis boundary.
causal_attribution_contract.exclusion: This gate does not decide public/private visibility or release eligibility. Information-boundary decisions remain in the public/private boundary gate.

exact_anchor_preservation_gate.purpose: Preserve exact identifiers and boundary words in external queries, public, release, citation, memory, and handoff surfaces. Query expansion may add variants but must not replace, shorten, normalize, prettify, or repair the original query or exact anchor.

current_status_table_evidence_gate.purpose: Prevent unverified notes from solidifying into current/status tables. Mutable fields need source checks or must be renamed as note/draft fields.

unknown_memory_reference_gate.purpose: When the user refers to a forgotten prior term, event, storage point, or old decision, search the relevant memory/event index before giving a named answer.
triggers: I forgot what it was called

hallucination_detection_anchor_gate.purpose: When judging whether an answer is hallucinated, complete, grounded, or task-satisfying, require source labels, evidence anchors, requested-output contract, or explicit unsupported/non-answer category.

global_task_context_gate.purpose: Prevent local fixes or useful side findings from displacing the user-approved primary goal. Preserve upstream goals, active lane, current status, file map, cross-step constraints, stop conditions, and an explicit split between blocking findings and deferred non-blocking findings. A user correction updates the current judgment first; it does not by itself authorize global router or policy edits.

novel_recurrence_candidate_gate.purpose: Lightweight re-evaluation for novel-looking failures that resemble prior failure shapes without matching a known gate. Mark a candidate recurrence or candidate global issue first; do not automatically run global, causal, feedback, memory-write, or R5 paths unless the re-evaluation upgrades the scope.
triggers: did not trigger the existing gate

linked_surface_sync_gate.purpose: Before changing linked governance surfaces such as router, policy, AGENTS, memory, ledger, adapter, or profile fields, enumerate the intended supported surfaces and the explicit non-target surfaces. Update only the user-requested or active supported surfaces; leave legacy or unnamed adapters as candidate debt unless explicitly requested.

public_private_surface_gate.purpose: Scan public-facing artifacts for private or local-only traces before publishing. Public surfaces must stay generic unless the user explicitly authorizes disclosure.

self_report_log_grounding_gate.purpose: Ground agent self-reports about prior checks, runs, validation, or skipped actions in actual command, tool, host, or session logs when such logs exist.

root_cause_cleanup_gate.purpose: For incident analysis, locate root causes and cleanup/prevention actions from logs, diffs, hashes, and source records. Do not turn it into blame or subjective intent claims.

lane_ownership_gate.purpose: A project or client name appearing in evidence is only a retrieval hit. Memory ownership requires task target, provenance, impact surface, and user authorization.

research_triage_gate.purpose: Decide whether a research/evaluator problem should follow a mechanical-verifier path, verifier-audit path, governance path, or mixed path before proposing target functions, reward loops, semantic judges, or model-internalization claims.

skill_audit_contract.decision_rule: Trigger only when a skill/capability subject and an audit/check/cleanup intent occur with at least one safety or redundancy signal. Route to the skill matrix, keep audit separate from immediate deletion, and require explicit authorization for later destructive cleanup.

first_principles_contract.decision_rule: Select by impact, uncertainty, reversibility, and persistence risk. Explicit design or first-principles requests use full_design; systemic/high-impact work uses constraint_gate; ordinary nontrivial changes use micro_constraints; trivial edits and simple version sync use none.

action_binding_contract.rule: Convert action-changing route decisions into the existing receipt. Retrieved prevention or reuse records become task-local candidate predictions, never standing constraints: review applicability, choose a candidate safe form only when relevant, observe the current-task outcome, then retire the review. Mechanically verified closed facts may enter the separate bind_verified_facts phase only with source refs, verification boundaries, conflict_status=none, a registered non-model producer receipt whose value hash matches, explicit consumers, and exact typed targets or answer slots; control facts are late-bound rather than rewritten by the model, while model_context and audit_only remain separate channels. The configured prediction/action counts are soft fast-path targets, never capability caps. Safety, lane, permission, claim, evidence, and correctness requirements outrank context cost. Deterministic runtime guards remain separate. Partition large transport payloads without semantic loss. A binding is complete only when coverage is sufficient or unresolved facets are explicit and its named completion evidence exists.

attribution: attribute the delay to the user
归因于用户需求不清晰
unverified: have not checked the original requirement

referenced_conversation_memory_contract.match_rule: Resolve only a unique highest-scoring active registry entry from title, aliases, retrieval terms, semantic anchors, or memory id. Ambiguous or missing candidates remain unresolved and do not open payloads.
referenced_conversation_memory_contract.completion_rule: A registry or outer-summary hit is navigation only. For a resolved referenced lane, read its meta, current state, explicit link ledger, and conversation-ledger index in one bounded read-only bundle; follow at most one explicit continuation edge, and open evidence/raw only when exact facts require it.

temporal_fragment_patterns: (?:十二|十一|十|[一二三四五六七八九])\s*月份?
vague_memory_recall_contract.candidate_only_rule: A temporal fragment, generic incident wording, or one vague semantic facet discovers bounded outer-index candidates only; it never selects an event or opens payload/raw evidence by itself.
vague_memory_recall_contract.payload_open_rule: Open paired memory or raw evidence only after an exact stable ID, a strong unique anchor, multiple independent matching facets with a unique lead, or explicit user confirmation of one candidate.

correction_lifecycle_contract.historical_replay_rule: A recurrence-effect claim requires at least one prior real failing short task with the same task goal, input shape, environment/tool surface, and acceptance condition. Synthetic fixtures remain unit evidence only.
correction_lifecycle_contract.cost_rule: Meta-first routing, one relevant family, and one unchanged-candidate evaluation are fast-path soft targets. If a component is necessary for real correction, target binding, verification, or postcondition evidence, effectiveness takes priority over file count, apparent simplicity, time, or token savings.
correction_lifecycle_contract.rule: Route only the relevant memory family, bind selected guidance to the actual current candidate, choose exactly one of auto_rewrite/preflight_validate/predictive_review/no_match, verify the declared postcondition, calibrate with current evidence, and retire task-local state. Profiles are promoted only through offline evidence review; no task may promote itself or write durable memory automatically.

capability_discovery_contract.rule: CBH emits a semantic discovery requirement and compact intent signature only. The independent capability router resolves registered candidates, then the agent verifies current host exposure. CBH does not copy the registry, inject schemas, authenticate, call tools, or create permissions.

task_continuity_contract.rule: CBH remains active. The persistent task-continuity layer sleeps by default. Use observe_once for a short write or single tool action so pre-action attention remains available without a cross-turn workfile. Arm persistent continuity only for a non-empty objective with a multi-step plan, explicit long-running/open-loop/continuation request, prior failure that must resume, or an existing active capsule. Track plan steps separately from acceptance evidence, continue from the earliest incomplete plan step, and retire only after the plan and required postconditions are complete or unresolved work is explicitly reported. Do not store chain-of-thought or create permission.

engineering_execution_contract.rule: Activate only the matching advisory profile. Keep ordinary tasks dormant. Tracer-bullet receipts expose a vertical delivery frontier and blocking edges; deep-module probes default to reversible freeze or temporary isolation, require rollback and audit evidence, and retain deletion only as the source thought experiment; invocation topology distinguishes request origin, actual runtime invoker, orchestration owner, and authority; adapter seams remain hypothetical until two independent verified host surfaces exercise the same core contract.

receipt_profiles.profile_rule: Always compute the full routing decision internally. Keep R0-R5 labels silent by default and expose only fields that change execution path, cost, permission, memory, conversation-linking, external search, or claim behavior. Expand only when governance, public/private, projectization, R4/R5, memory write, conversation-link, strong claim, or debug triggers require it.

compact_runtime.purpose: default low-cost runtime receipt for ordinary nontrivial tasks and single-user local agents

extended_governance.purpose: expanded receipt for framework rules, public repositories, adapters, project memory, conversation memory, projectization, archive, persona, and cross-boundary governance

debug_receipt.purpose: full diagnostic receipt for router development and misroute debugging

cost_control_contract.action_relevant_rule: Only emit or load a field by default if it can change the next action. Otherwise keep it in docs, archive meta, debug receipt, or audit logs.
cost_control_contract.classification_visibility_rule: R0-R5 classification always runs internally. User-facing replies and prompt-stage context stay silent unless classification changes execution path, cost, permission, memory, external search, or claim boundary. Debug or audit requests expose the full receipt.

routing_field_budget.R1_R2: usually implicit; compact_runtime only when an action-changing gate appears
routing_field_budget.R3_R4: compact_runtime plus triggered fields only; do not display risk labels unless needed for boundary explanation

cost_control_contract.delta_receipt_rule: After the initial receipt, re-evaluation should emit changed fields only unless full debug is requested.

memory_routing_contract.purpose: decide whether memory should be read, written, updated, or skipped before opening memory payloads
memory_routing_contract.default_rule: Ordinary chat and projectless small fixes do not write memory unless the user explicitly asks, an error is recurring/reusable, a conversation checkpoint is needed, or projectization drift is detected.
memory_routing_contract.explicit_record_rule: If the user says to record this error/problem/mistake or asks for self-reflection matrix recording, route to the self-reflection matrix or common error corpus according to severity.
memory_routing_contract.common_error_rule: Small but recurring execution mistakes should enter common_error_corpus as lightweight CE error-and-solution records. A CE record must include the mistake, cause, applied solution, prevention rule, validation, and evidence; only high-impact, repeated, cross-project-dangerous, durable-wrong-edit, or explicitly escalated incidents upgrade to paired ERR/SOL records.
memory_routing_contract.common_error_auto_append_rule: A log-verified, solved, validated, reusable, project-private-free local CE may be appended without another user prompt and must be disclosed in the final response. This narrow R3 exception is append-only: it cannot delete or overwrite records, cross lanes, include private project payload, upgrade ERR/SOL, or modify router/policy. Any deviation remains R5.
memory_routing_contract.conversation_memory_rule: Projectless long-running conversations may create or update a current_conversation lane only from an explicit conversation-memory/write request or separately authorized durable write. Merely having an ACTIVE lane, performing an ordinary fix, crossing a complexity threshold, or entering R4/R5 does not convert the current task into a memory update; those signals may produce a read-only checkpoint_candidate. Read-current-memory wording routes to memory_mode=read and memory_lane=current_conversation. Active-lane discovery must match the registered workspace and, when available, thread id; ambiguous multiple lanes return no automatic lane. Cross-conversation writes require explicit user instruction.
memory_routing_contract.source_monitoring_schema_rule: Reusable memory capsules should preserve source_tag, belief_status, structured confidence, derived_from, source_monitoring, lifecycle, and belief_trace_summary. Optional numeric scores are adapter metadata and must not replace confidence basis or provenance.
memory_routing_contract.retrieval_result_rule: Reusable memory retrieval results must include source_tag, derived_from, belief_status, confidence, and score_method with the selected text. If no numeric score is computed, use score_method=none and omit score.
memory_routing_contract.projectization_rule: If projectless work accumulates durable files, versioning, repository/docs, tests, adapters, releases, or repeated architecture decisions, mark emergent_project_candidate and ask or state the lane assumption before durable memory writes.

global_archive_contract.memory_file_index_rule: Index every discovered memory or ledger file by stable logical root plus relative path, current locator, size, mtime, and SHA-256. Backup/archive files remain cold and are never active retrieval candidates merely because they are indexed.
global_archive_contract.stable_identity_rule: Memory and incident records bind to a stable source_id; absolute paths are mutable locators, not source identity.
global_archive_contract.candidate_discovery_boundary: Vague temporal or semantic clues may read compact outer-index metadata and return a bounded candidate list, but cannot select an event, open raw evidence, or reactivate a historical solution without a unique strong anchor or user confirmation.
global_archive_contract.default_lookup_rule: Use active project or conversation lane first. Read the global archive only when the user asks for archive lookup, the active lane has no relevant record, or a lane is being sealed or snapshotted.
global_archive_contract.summary_capsule_rule: ARCHIVE_SUMMARY_CAPSULE requires explicit compression, migration, de-identification, public-release, or storage-reduction intent. Do not delete the source unless separately confirmed.

cold_evidence_boundary.active_retrieval_rule: Do not inject cold evidence as current guidance. Promotion into an active lane requires a separate memory write/update route with source-monitoring metadata and explicit user or project authorization.

context_backup_append_contract.purpose: Preserve full-detail context and execution evidence without forcing project or conversation rollup memories to duplicate it.
context_backup_append_contract.rule: When a detailed context-backup memory is enabled, update means appending or patching only the selected new segment with original context, logs, refs, and hashes when available. Do not replace it with a lossy summary and do not regenerate the entire file for an ordinary update.

rollup_slimming_profile.rule: When a context-backup memory or raw ledger preserves the full detail, rollup memories should store compact event/domain/decision/error/source capsules plus evidence_refs instead of duplicating every turn, tool log, error, or diff.
rollup_slimming_profile.old_memory_migration_rule: Do not migrate old memories just to match this profile. Apply it to future writes and future updates.

persona_state_policy.durable_user_profile_rule: Only explicit operating preferences may be durable. Do not persist personality, motives, identity, emotional profile, or persona assumptions by default.

steps: read memory_summary, _META_INDEX, or router manifest first
select one category index, point index, or outer_retrieval_surface
open only the matching capsule, ERR point, SOL point, or status payload
memory_retrieval_chain.missing_meta_rule: If no meta summary exists, use the smallest available top-level index or manifest as a temporary meta layer, mark the missing meta layer as an adaptation gap, and avoid broad memory/history scans.

dynamic_evaluation_governance.cost_rule: Use the cheapest sufficient route; do not load all memory, all skills, or all history because the dynamic layer is active.
dynamic_evaluation_governance.failure_rule: If dynamic evaluation cannot be completed, mark the final answer as dynamically incomplete or unverified.

conversation_linking_contract.active_lookup_scope_rule: Latest means latest active memory inside the current project lane or PROJECTLESS lane, never global latest across unrelated lanes.

mandatory_advisory_control_plane.purpose: make routing, dynamic evaluation, and constitution governance continuously effective without wrapping every tool call
mandatory_advisory_control_plane.cost_rule: Use L0 only for ordinary chat; use lightweight receipts for nontrivial work; run script gates only for ambiguous boundaries, R4/R5, strong claims, memory writes, or explicit hardening.
mandatory_advisory_control_plane.failure_rule: If the control plane was skipped, downgrade final claims and say which boundary was not checked.

search_and_learning_decision_matrix.purpose: avoid closed-door invention, lossy query rewriting, narrow-source retrieval, and assumption-filled external claims

official_authority_source_search.boundary: Use official or authority sources first for drift-prone public facts; cross-check when practical.

github_open_source_repository_search.boundary: Separate repository identity, README intent, source-code facts, release or issue evidence, activity signals, and license boundaries.

general_web_cross_check.boundary: Use independent sources when practical; mark source limits when evidence is thin.

source_grounded_learning_intake.boundary: Build a source ledger, classify material, preserve non-applicable boundaries, and require local validation before adoption-success claims.

search_and_learning_decision_matrix.anti_closed_door_rule: For external mechanisms, public repositories, current facts, unfamiliar methods, or explicit search requests, do not rely on local reasoning alone. Search or mark the result as unverified.

external_retrieval_contract.merge_policy: Never merge an exact-anchor query into semantic expansion. Keep one reserved result path per exact anchor; canonicalize and deduplicate candidates, fuse heterogeneous ranked lists only as a ranking aid, rerank against the original task, and preserve provenance.
external_retrieval_contract.fallback_rule: If a checked surface is weak, empty, conflicting, unavailable, or loses an exact anchor, keep the original query and anchor query, then use the matching source-native search or known direct URL before broadening semantic variants.
external_retrieval_contract.negative_claim_rule: A provider, index, Top-K, snippet, or AI-search miss is only not_found_in_checked_sources or retrieval_inconclusive, never proof of absence. verified_absent requires a complete closed-world source, an authority's direct negative statement, or a verifiable known-address not-found result.
external_retrieval_contract.coverage_rule: Stop only when every required exact anchor is bound to a planned query and verified at a matching primary source, and every distinct required facet is supported or explicitly unresolved. In multi-entity tasks, each facet is first linked to the anchor in its local clause; ambiguous associations retain semantic_review_required. A source route must be registered and allowed by the linked target; routes without a mechanically known canonical URL require an explicit verified-for-target authority binding. Current or revision-sensitive claims require a timezone-aware checked-at value, a positive claim-specific freshness window, and a stated freshness basis, and unresolved source conflict prevents completion. Snippets and ranking scores locate candidates but are not final evidence.
external_retrieval_contract.cost_rule: Execute the original query and each exact anchor independently. Use a small first wave, then expand only for an unresolved anchor, distinct facet, weak evidence, conflict, or unavailable source; do not impose a hard source or query cap that drops required coverage.
external_retrieval_contract.external_memory_boundary: External candidates and source ledgers are task-local evidence. They do not enter durable memory unless a separately governed memory-write event is authorized.
external_retrieval_contract.source_capability_rule: Choose source-native routes from typed anchors and explicit source context. A provider hint is a route candidate, not proof of ownership or existence; verify the canonical source before completing the facet.
external_retrieval_contract.unknown_source_rule: For an untyped namespace or named entity, run capability/source discovery and retain semantic_review_required. Do not silently reinterpret it as GitHub, Hugging Face, a package registry, or an official site.
external_retrieval_contract.currentness_evidence_rule: For a current or revision-sensitive claim, checked_at must be a timezone-aware ISO-8601 timestamp, must not be beyond the configured future-skew tolerance, and must fall inside the positive claim-specific freshness_window_seconds declared with a non-empty freshness_basis. The declared window cannot exceed the contract's task-local maximum, and the caller remains responsible for choosing a stricter window appropriate to the volatility of the claim; otherwise retain semantic_review_required.
external_retrieval_contract.rule: Freeze exact identifiers, preserve and execute the original query, keep exact and semantic lanes separate, select source-native fallbacks by capability, verify candidate sources, track per-query coverage and provenance, and retain an explicit inconclusive state. This contract plans and evaluates retrieval but does not browse, block, or write memory.

official_entity.authority_boundary: An official page can establish the entity's own statement or current metadata; independent claims still require an appropriate cross-check.

doi_resolver.authority_boundary: doi.org resolves the identifier; resolver or registration metadata does not by itself validate the publication's substantive claims.

crossref_metadata.authority_boundary: Crossref metadata can establish records registered with Crossref. A miss does not exclude DataCite or another DOI registration agency, and metadata does not validate publication claims.

datacite_metadata.authority_boundary: DataCite metadata can establish records registered with DataCite. A miss is scoped to that registry and does not validate publication claims.

rfc_editor.authority_boundary: The RFC Editor text is the canonical RFC publication surface; later errata or obsolescence status still need checking.

rfc_status.authority_boundary: The RFC Editor info surface records publication status, updates, obsoletes links, and errata navigation; current protocol registries may still require IANA.

standards_registry.authority_boundary: The issuing standards body is authoritative for identifier, edition, and lifecycle status. Public metadata does not imply access to or validation of a paywalled full text.

arxiv.authority_boundary: arXiv is the primary preprint surface; peer-review or publication status must be verified separately.

cve_record.authority_boundary: The CVE record establishes the canonical identifier and published record; severity, exploitability, and vendor remediation may require NVD and vendor advisories.

nvd_cve.authority_boundary: NVD enriches CVE records with analysis and references; vendor remediation and exploit status still require vendor advisories or the relevant operational authority.

pypi.authority_boundary: PyPI is authoritative for the published Python distribution metadata on that registry, not for unrelated source-repository or runtime claims.

npm.authority_boundary: npm is authoritative for package metadata published to npm; repository, security, and runtime behavior require their matching sources.

huggingface.authority_boundary: The Hugging Face repository or model card is primary for material published there; model capability and safety claims remain source claims until independently evaluated.

github_repository.authority_boundary: A GitHub repository can establish repository identity and its own code/docs/releases; it does not establish broader independent claims.

namespace_discovery.authority_boundary: This route identifies the owning registry or service. It cannot establish existence, ownership, or canonical URL until a matching source is opened.

runtime_enforcement.activation_boundary: Direct routing, evidence, memory-isolation, and deletion-risk classification remain advisory. The only behavior-changing CBH Codex user hook is a stateless nonblocking behavior-correction migration at PreToolUse: it may return allow plus updatedInput for an accepted deterministic profile, and otherwise emits nothing. Its matcher covers only the native Bash tool surface; nested shell text inside functions.exec or another orchestration tool is not mechanically intercepted and requires one direct pretool gate call when a known mechanically matched recurrence is selected. A separate SessionStart callback supplies usage telemetry only. No memory-navigation or ledger-checkpoint lifecycle Hook is registered; the retained lifecycle_bridge.mjs file is direct-call reference code with no automatic host consumer. There is no CBH deny hook, generic R5, permission-request, Stop, wrapper, proxy, key, TTL, approval state, or session-freeze chain.

dangerous_delete_advisory_contract.authority_boundary: The receipt is evidence for agent judgment only. It cannot authorize, deny, sandbox, freeze, persist approval, or consume a retry.
dangerous_delete_advisory_contract.execution_boundary: Agent instructions, explicit user scope, and native host sandbox or permission policy remain authoritative.
dangerous_delete_advisory_contract.rule: Classify deletion risk only when explicitly invoked; never register this advisor as a hook or treat its output as an execution decision.

behavior_correction_contract.rule: Behavior-correction profiles bind one unchanged current candidate to a source-linked correction family and exactly one decision mode. Only an accepted deterministic auto_rewrite profile can alter current native Bash input; validation and predictive-review profiles remain advisory. Outcomes require the declared verifier/postcondition and task-local retirement; promotion and durable memory updates remain offline explicit maintenance.

migration_hook.rule: Accepted deterministic profiles may transparently rewrite only the current native Bash tool input after exact binding and real-parser verification. Uncovered nested shell surfaces use at most one direct pretool advisory evaluation for a known recurrence and remain agent-owned. The hook and fallback never deny, persist state, write memory, mutate policy, or grant authority.

claim_schema_contract.rule: Claims may pass schema completeness only when source_type and evidence_boundary are enumerated. Strong final phrases require a claim whose evidence boundary is at least local regression strength.

gate_enforcement_boundary: Routing receipts are advisory. Task-scoped authorization remains valid within its agreed scope; changed scope or new external/irreversible effects require corresponding authorization. Fields do not grant authority. Host-enforced execution blocking exists only on explicitly verified native surfaces.

explicit_mutation_phrases: if a fix is needed, update
